title: SUPERVISORY MANPOWER ANALYST with Security Clearance

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.
cond_0001.requirements:
Conditions of Employment
Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit e-verify.gov
Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
Supervisors in the executive branch have a heightened personal responsibility for advancing government ethics. You will be required to review the 14 General Principles of Ethical Conduct at 5 CFR 2635.101.
Minimum Requirements
At least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization to identify and advise on workforce planning issues and develop recommendations to ensure personnel readiness and efficient program operations.
Preferred Requirements
Successful completion of a master's or equivalent graduate degree, OR successful completion of two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree, OR possession of an LL.B. Or J.D. That is related to this position being filled.
A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience.
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit e-verify.gov
Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
Supervisors in the executive branch have a heightened personal responsibility for advancing government ethics. You will be required to review the 14 General Principles of Ethical Conduct at 5 CFR 2635.101.
Qualifications
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization to identify and advise on workforce planning issues and develop recommendations to ensure personnel readiness and efficient program operations.
Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
Education
In lieu of specialized experience, you may qualify with the following education or combination of both education and experience:
Successful completion of a master's or equivalent graduate degree OR Successful completion of two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree OR Possession of an LL.B. Or J.D. That is related to this position being filled.
Https://www.usajobs.gov/Help/working-in-government/unique-hiring-paths/students/federal-occupations-by-college-major/
OR A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience. A transcript must be submitted with your application if qualifying using education. See Required Documents for additional information.
Additional information
This position is limited to the commute area of the duty location listed for this position. The commuting area is defined as the geographic area surrounding a duty location that encompasses the localities in which people live or work and can reasonably be expected to travel back and forth daily to their usual employment.
This position is covered by the Department of Defense Priority Placement Program.
Additional vacancies may be filled by this announcement.
A tentative offer of employment will be rescinded if the selectee fails to meet the pre-employment requirements, including failure to report to any of the scheduled appointments.
Federal annuitant information: The selection of an annuitant is subject to the Department of Defense and Department of the Navy policy on the employment of annuitants. Policy information may be found at: http://www.secnav.navy.mil/donhr/Documents/CivilianJobs/FedCivAnnuitants.pdf
ICTAP Applicants: To be considered well-qualified and exercise selection priority as an ICTAP candidate, displaced Federal employees must satisfy all qualification requirements for the position and receive a rating in the highly qualified category (score 85) or higher. ICTAP candidates must provide copies of all of the following documentation at the time of application: 1) agency notice; 2) most recent performance appraisal; and 3) most recent SF-50 or notification of personnel action that includes position, grade level, and duty location. Applicants who do not provide this documentation will not receive consideration as an ICTAP candidate. For more information about ICTAP eligibility please review the following link: https://www.usajobs.gov/Help/working-in-government/unique-hiring-paths/federal-employees/career-transition/
Military Spouse Preference applicants will be placed at the highest grade for which they have applied and are determined Best Qualified (BQ). A BQ military spouse possesses knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies comparable to others who meet the competitive referral criteria for the specific position.
PPP applicants will be placed at the FPL, if determined Well Qualified (WQ). To receive priority consideration, the FPL must be the same grade level or equivalent of the retained grade or the grade held immediately prior to separation.
How You Will Be Evaluated
You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above. In order to qualify for this position, your resume must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the specific position for which you are being considered. Your resume is the key means we have for evaluating your skills, knowledge, and abilities as they relate to this position. Therefore, we encourage you to be clear and specific when describing your experience.
When the application process is complete, we will review your resume to ensure you meet the hiring eligibility and qualification requirements listed in this announcement. You will be rated based on the information provided in your resume and responses to the Occupational Questionnaire, along with your supporting documentation to determine your ability to demonstrate the following competencies:
ADMINISTRATION AND MANAGEMENT
MANAGING HUMAN RESOURCES
ORAL COMMUNICATION
PLANNING AND EVALUATING
PROBLEM SOLVING
RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
You should list any relevant performance appraisals and incentive awards in your resume as that information may be taken into consideration during the selection process. If selected, you may be required to provide supporting documentation.

cond_0014.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with manpower management and personnel administration.
cond_0014.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
Supervisors in the executive branch have a heightened personal responsibility for advancing government ethics. You will be required to review the 14 General Principles of Ethical Conduct at 5 CFR 2635.101.
Qualifications
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization to identify and advise on workforce planning issues and develop recommendations to ensure personnel readiness and efficient program operations.
Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series

Successful completion of a master's or equivalent graduate degree OR Successful completion of two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree OR Possession of an LL.B. Or J.D. That is related to this position being filled.

cond_0051.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0051.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components, staying in regular contact with the teams involved.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel, working closely and on an ongoing basis with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, actively communicating with relevant parties to ensure all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead the Personnel Section in close collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, regularly connecting with subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5) to plan and coordinate the work to be accomplished.
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities, speaking up early when adjustments are needed.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, handle staff scheduling, evaluate staff performance, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking — walking team members through expectations and clarifying requirements directly.
You will plan, schedule, direct, and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section, keeping communication active across the section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates and staying in regular contact to meet deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources, and explain trade-offs clearly to relevant stakeholders.
cond_0051.requirements:
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization to identify and advise on workforce planning issues and develop recommendations to ensure personnel readiness and efficient program operations.
In lieu of specialized experience, you may qualify with the following education or combination of both education and experience:
Successful completion of a master's or equivalent graduate degree OR Successful completion of two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree OR Possession of an LL.B. Or J.D. That is related to this position being filled.
OR A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience. A transcript must be submitted with your application if qualifying using education.
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
Conditions of Employment:
Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check.
Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
Supervisors in the executive branch have a heightened personal responsibility for advancing government ethics. You will be required to review the 14 General Principles of Ethical Conduct at 5 CFR 2635.101.
You will be evaluated based on the following competencies:
Administration and Management
Managing Human Resources
Oral Communication
Planning and Evaluating
Problem Solving
Resource Management

cond_0107.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team at [Location masked].
cond_0107.responsibilities:
You will take ownership of management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will direct all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel, leading coordination with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead the Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, directing the work accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, set staff scheduling, evaluate staff performance, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, managing workload for self and subordinates to meet deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will execute organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.
cond_0107.requirements:
Conditions of Employment
Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit e-verify.gov
Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
Supervisors in the executive branch have a heightened personal responsibility for advancing government ethics. You will be required to review the 14 General Principles of Ethical Conduct at 5 CFR 2635.101.
Qualifications
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization to identify and advise on workforce planning issues and develop recommendations to ensure personnel readiness and efficient program operations.
Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
Education
In lieu of specialized experience, you may qualify with the following education or combination of both education and experience:
Successful completion of a master's or equivalent graduate degree OR Successful completion of two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree OR Possession of an LL.B. Or J.D. That is related to this position being filled.
Https://www.usajobs.gov/Help/working-in-government/unique-hiring-paths/students/federal-occupations-by-college-major/
OR A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience. A transcript must be submitted with your application if qualifying using education. See Required Documents for additional information.
Additional information
This position is limited to the commute area of the duty location listed for this position. The commuting area is defined as the geographic area surrounding a duty location that encompasses the localities in which people live or work and can reasonably be expected to travel back and forth daily to their usual employment.
This position is covered by the Department of Defense Priority Placement Program.
Additional vacancies may be filled by this announcement.
A tentative offer of employment will be rescinded if the selectee fails to meet the pre-employment requirements, including failure to report to any of the scheduled appointments.
Federal annuitant information: The selection of an annuitant is subject to the Department of Defense and Department of the Navy policy on the employment of annuitants. Policy information may be found at: http://www.secnav.navy.mil/donhr/Documents/CivilianJobs/FedCivAnnuitants.pdf
ICTAP Applicants: To be considered well-qualified and exercise selection priority as an ICTAP candidate, displaced Federal employees must satisfy all qualification requirements for the position and receive a rating in the highly qualified category (score 85) or higher. ICTAP candidates must provide copies of all of the following documentation at the time of application: 1) agency notice; 2) most recent performance appraisal; and 3) most recent SF-50 or notification of personnel action that includes position, grade level, and duty location. Applicants who do not provide this documentation will not receive consideration as an ICTAP candidate. For more information about ICTAP eligibility please review the following link: https://www.usajobs.gov/Help/working-in-government/unique-hiring-paths/federal-employees/career-transition/
Military Spouse Preference applicants will be placed at the highest grade for which they have applied and are determined Best Qualified (BQ). A BQ military spouse possesses knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies comparable to others who meet the competitive referral criteria for the specific position.
PPP applicants will be placed at the FPL, if determined Well Qualified (WQ). To receive priority consideration, the FPL must be the same grade level or equivalent of the retained grade or the grade held immediately prior to separation.
How You Will Be Evaluated
You will be evaluated for this job based on how well you meet the qualifications above. In order to qualify for this position, your resume must provide sufficient experience and/or education, knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the specific position for which you are being considered. Your resume is the key means we have for evaluating your skills, knowledge, and abilities as they relate to this position. Therefore, we encourage you to be clear and specific when describing your experience.
When the application process is complete, we will review your resume to ensure you meet the hiring eligibility and qualification requirements listed in this announcement. You will be rated based on the information provided in your resume and responses to the Occupational Questionnaire, along with your supporting documentation to determine your ability to demonstrate the following competencies:
ADMINISTRATION AND MANAGEMENT
MANAGING HUMAN RESOURCES
ORAL COMMUNICATION
PLANNING AND EVALUATING
PROBLEM SOLVING
RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
You should list any relevant performance appraisals and incentive awards in your resume as that information may be taken into consideration during the selection process. If selected, you may be required to provide supporting documentation.

cond_0141.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0141.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components, staying in regular contact with the teams involved.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel, working closely and on an ongoing basis with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, actively communicating with relevant parties to ensure all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead the Personnel Section in close collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, regularly connecting with subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5) to plan and coordinate the work to be accomplished.
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities, speaking up early when adjustments are needed.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, handle staff scheduling, evaluate staff performance, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking — walking team members through expectations and clarifying requirements directly.
You will plan, schedule, direct, and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section, keeping communication active across the section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates and staying in regular contact to meet deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources, and explain trade-offs clearly to relevant stakeholders.
cond_0141.requirements:
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization to identify and advise on workforce planning issues and develop recommendations to ensure personnel readiness and efficient program operations.
In lieu of specialized experience, you may qualify with the following education or combination of both education and experience:
Successful completion of a master's or equivalent graduate degree OR Successful completion of two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree OR Possession of an LL.B. Or J.D. That is related to this position being filled.
OR A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience. A transcript must be submitted with your application if qualifying using education.
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
Conditions of Employment:
Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check.
Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
Supervisors in the executive branch have a heightened personal responsibility for advancing government ethics. You will be required to review the 14 General Principles of Ethical Conduct at 5 CFR 2635.101.
You will be evaluated based on the following competencies:
Administration and Management
Managing Human Resources
Oral Communication
Planning and Evaluating
Problem Solving
Resource Management

cond_0163.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0163.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

cond_0175.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manpower management and personnel administration.
cond_0175.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

cond_0221.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with manpower management and personnel administration.
cond_0221.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

Conditions of Employment

Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.

Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.

You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.

Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, visit e-verify.gov
Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
Supervisors in the executive branch have a heightened personal responsibility for advancing government ethics. You will be required to review the 14 General Principles of Ethical Conduct at 5 CFR 2635.101.
Minimum Requirements
At least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization to identify and advise on workforce planning issues and develop recommendations to ensure personnel readiness and efficient program operations.
Preferred Requirements
Successful completion of a master's or equivalent graduate degree; OR successful completion of two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree; OR possession of an LL.B. Or J.D. Related to this position.
A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience.
A transcript must be submitted with your application if qualifying using education. See Required Documents for additional information.
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
cond_0243.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.
cond_0243.inclusion: At [Company name masked], we're not all the same. And that's our greatest strength. We draw on the differences in who we are, what we've experienced and how we think. Because to create products that serve everyone, we believe in including everyone. Therefore, we are committed to treating all applicants fairly and equally.
cond_0243.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.

cond_0244.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0244.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

cond_0249.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0249.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components, staying in regular contact with the teams involved.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel, working closely and on an ongoing basis with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, actively communicating with relevant parties to ensure all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead the Personnel Section in close collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, regularly connecting with subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5) to plan and coordinate the work to be accomplished.
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities, speaking up early when adjustments are needed.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, handle staff scheduling, evaluate staff performance, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking — walking team members through expectations and clarifying requirements directly.
You will plan, schedule, direct, and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section, keeping communication active across the section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates and staying in regular contact to meet deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources, and explain trade-offs clearly to relevant stakeholders.
cond_0249.requirements:

You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components, staying in regular contact with personnel across both units.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel, working closely and daily with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure they have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements, and actively communicate any concerns early.

You will plan, schedule, direct, and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section, initiating discussions to resolve issues and keep work on track.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates and meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources, and walk leadership through your findings and recommendations.

cond_0321.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0321.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components, staying in regular contact with the teams involved.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel, working closely and on an ongoing basis with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, actively communicating with relevant parties to ensure all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead the Personnel Section in close collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, regularly connecting with subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5) to plan and coordinate the work to be accomplished.
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities, speaking up early when adjustments are needed.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, handle staff scheduling, evaluate staff performance, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking — walking team members through expectations and clarifying requirements directly.
You will plan, schedule, direct, and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section, keeping communication active across the section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates and staying in regular contact to meet deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources, and explain trade-offs clearly to relevant stakeholders.
cond_0321.requirements:
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization to identify and advise on workforce planning issues and develop recommendations to ensure personnel readiness and efficient program operations.
In lieu of specialized experience, you may qualify with the following education or combination of both education and experience:
Successful completion of a master's or equivalent graduate degree OR Successful completion of two full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree OR Possession of an LL.B. Or J.D. That is related to this position being filled.
OR A combination of experience and graduate education as described above that equates to one year of experience. A transcript must be submitted with your application if qualifying using education.
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
Conditions of Employment:
Must be a US Citizen.
Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.
New employees to the Department of the Navy will be required to successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check.
Generally, current federal employees applying for GS jobs must serve at least one year at the next lower grade level. This requirement is called time-in-grade. Time-in-grade requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.
Within the Department of Defense (DoD), the appointment of retired military members within 180 days immediately following retirement date to a civilian position is subject to the provisions of 5 United States Code 3326.
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service.
You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.
Supervisors in the executive branch have a heightened personal responsibility for advancing government ethics. You will be required to review the 14 General Principles of Ethical Conduct at 5 CFR 2635.101.
You will be evaluated based on the following competencies:
Administration and Management
Managing Human Resources
Oral Communication
Planning and Evaluating
Problem Solving
Resource Management

You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

Must be determined suitable for federal employment.
Must participate in the direct deposit pay program.

You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.
This position may require travel from normal duty station to CONUS and OCONUS and may include remote or isolated sites. You must be able to travel on military and commercial aircraft for extended periods of time.

Minimum Requirements
Proven track record of at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-07 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing manpower utilization and providing administrative services (e.g. Training, assignments, records, PCS orders) for an organization.
Deep knowledge of workforce planning issues, with a demonstrated ability to advise on personnel readiness and develop recommendations to ensure efficient program operations.
Exceptional oral communication skills and strong leadership abilities, including the capacity to influence and direct subordinates across varied grade levels.
Advanced knowledge of planning, evaluating, and managing human resources in a structured organizational environment.

cond_0343.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0343.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

cond_0350.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0350.responsibilities:
You will own management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will direct all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel, leading coordination with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead the Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, directing the work accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will set goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, drive staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, taking ownership of workload prioritization for self and subordinates to meet deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will execute organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.

cond_0361.intro: We are looking for a Supervisory Manpower Analyst to join our team.
cond_0361.responsibilities:
You will provide management support for all facets of the Sea Operational Detachment (SEAOPDET) and P3 Operational Detachment (P3OPDET) components.
You will coordinate all administrative and records requirements for deploying personnel working closely with Personnel Support Detachments (PERSUPPDET), the medical/dental treatment facilities, and supported ships, squadrons, and activities.
You will track Projected Rotation (PRD) and End of Active Obligated Service (EAOS) dates of assigned personnel to ensure assigned personnel have adequate time onboard to complete deployment requirements.
You will oversee the personnel receipt/transfer process, ensuring all administrative, special duty screening, and reporting requirements are accurately and promptly adhered to and tracked.
You will develop and maintain manual and/or electronic organizational roster board for each UIC per the Naval Aviation Maintenance Program (NAMP).
You will lead Personnel Section in collaboration with the Admin Leading Chief Petty Officer, including planning the work to be accomplished by subordinates who perform at varied levels ranging from E1 to E5 (equivalent GS-1 to GS-5).
You will plan and assign work based on priorities as well as consideration of the difficulty and requirements of the assignments as compared with member's capabilities.
You will define goals, determine technical objectives and priorities, establish performance standards, staff scheduling and evaluate staff performance accordingly, and provide guidance and direction in support of branch and command tasking.
You will plan, schedule, direct and coordinate the full range of service functions of the Command Personnel Section.
You will supervise seven assigned military personnel ranging in grades E1-E5, prioritizing workload for self and subordinates meeting deadlines relative to overall project scheduling.
You will perform organizational and/or manpower utilization studies on a limited scale in a stable environment to identify and develop improvements in the efficiency of manpower management methods.
You will develop statistical and narrative data to justify work unit reorganization or positional restructuring as a more productive or efficient use of personnel resources.
